_comment: Words that split one utterance into item phrases, and filler words the parser drops.
_fillerComment: Do NOT add number words here: ఒక is one, వెయ్యి is a thousand (V1: 'వెయ్యి రూపాయల బియ్యం' lost its amount when it was a filler).
_currencyComment: A number followed by a currency word means 'this many rupees worth' (పది రూపాయల ఉల్లిపాయలు = ₹10 of onions).
